purpose: Separate semantic and readout sensitivity from accessible-representation loss for emotion and offensive-tweet transfer.

selection.order: SHA-256 of seed, source, and source-namespaced parent
selection.duplicate_policy: Collapse exact same-label duplicates and remove every parent with conflicting labels.
selection.exclusions: Remove consumed training, calibration, public-development parents, and rendered states before selection.

semantic_variants: every cyclic option rotation with inverse semantic mapping
opaque option keys with the original descriptions
one class-definition lexicon derived only from the native taxonomy

primitive_rules.choice: Apply candidate rotations only with inverse semantic remapping.
primitive_rules.noul: Preserve declared yes-first polarity; do not rotate options.
primitive_rules.score: Preserve the declared ordinal rubric; do not rotate options.

emotion_populations.native_probe: Fit and score the six-class feature probe only where the question has exactly the six native labels and the gold label is native.
emotion_populations.augmented_report: Report questions containing or targeting none_of_these as a separate stratum.
emotion_populations.mapping_rule: Do not score a seventh probe class unless a deterministic mapping from six-class probe probabilities is frozen before inference.

feature_probe.representation: Final-layer mean over state tokens excluding special and padding tokens.

calibration.multiclass: One positive scalar per domain fitted on support-calibration only.
calibration.offensive: One positive-slope logistic calibrator with intercept fitted on support-calibration only.

diagnostic_flags.accessible_feature_regression: Original probe accuracy exceeds generation-79 probe accuracy by at least 0.05 with a positive one-sided 97.5% parent lower bound.
diagnostic_flags.task_or_readout_sensitivity: A frozen-feature readout or frozen semantic variant recovers at least half the historical target gap.
diagnostic_flags.calibration_only: NLL or Brier improves without better class ordering or AUROC.

M3_required_bindings: exact generation-79 checkpoint, original-backbone, tokenizer, model-configuration, and runtime identities
source-namespaced support-fit and support-calibration parent membership with file digests
all rendered original, cyclic, opaque-key, and native-taxonomy input strings
development exclusion indices and separate native versus augmented emotion membership
fixed classifier, standardizer, scalar-temperature, and offensive logistic-calibrator fitting rules
per-arm sequence counts and the aggregate encoded-sequence budget
prohibited: claims of causal proof or zero-shot transfer after support fitting
